sheets.name: Framework and materials
rows: SOC 2 Type II is on the FRC-CLA-ASF list and was performed by an independent service auditor. The completion date is within 12 months of today under either reading.

The client plans to submit in the second quarter of 2027 but has set no date. If the period end counts as completion, the window closes on 2027-06-30, inside that quarter. The next report, expected in February 2027, would open a new window.
Set the submission date, decide DQ-001, and plan to submit with the February 2027 report if the date falls after the window closes.
The consultant received the full report.
The examination period ended on 2026-06-30 and no letter covers the time since. The GRC Lead says the auditor issues one on request.
Request a bridge letter from the service auditor covering 2026-07-01 to the submission date.
The signed engagement letter was supplied. Nothing shows how the engagement can be verified with the auditor.
Ask the auditor how a party can verify the engagement, and record the contact and method in the package.
Estimated schedule for the next report
An email from the auditor gives the next period (2026-07-01 to 2026-12-31) and a report expected in February 2027.
None was supplied. The material does not show whether any is applicable.
